messages.subject: Question about irf
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

This is Owen Yang, a current master student.

I am working on a bivariate VECM model and I need to draw the Impulse Response Function (IRF) based on my estimation results. However, when I am trying to use the function "irf" from package "tsDyn", the input for "n.ahead" doesn't work: no matter what number I put there, the estimation results always show 10 steps ahead.

Could you tell me the reason why this happen?

Thanks in advance.

I attached my R script and my data file into this email in case you need to double check.

Best,

Owen

messages.body_plain:

It looks like you are writing n.head instead of n.ahead?

In case the problem persists, do not hesitate to write back, providing a minimal self-reproducible example instead of your data.

Best

Matthieu
